parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the refrigerator is made of steel, forming the structural skeleton that supports the entire appliance.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity and stability to the refrigerator, ensuring that all other components are securely attached and aligned.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is a fixed, non-moving part that serves as the main support structure.

parts.name: Body Interior
parts.Basic_description: The body interior of the refrigerator is made of ABS plastic, forming the inner compartment where food and beverages are stored.
parts.Functional_description: It provides insulation and a clean, easy-to-maintain surface for storing items at low temperatures.
parts.Movement_description: The interior body is fixed and does not move; it houses shelves and compartments.

parts.name: Door (Freezer Door)
parts.Basic_description: The upper door of the refrigerator, likely the freezer door, is made of steel with an insulated core.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the freezer compartment to maintain low temperatures and prevent frost buildup.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges, allowing access to the freezer compartment.

parts.name: Door (Main Door)
parts.Basic_description: The main refrigerator door is made of steel with insulation inside, covering the main storage compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the main cooling area and maintains the internal temperature when closed.
parts.Movement_description: The door swings open and closed on hinges, allowing users to access the refrigerator interior.
